name: payment
title: Payment
description: Provider-agnostic payments for Lunora — Stripe-first checkout, metered usage tracking, entitlement checks, billing portal, and subscription queries built on @lunora/payment. Scaffolds the checkout / track / check / portal / subscriptions / webhook functions plus the payment tables to declare in your schema. The provider adapter is wired into createShardDO (see docs).
docs: FIRST: declare the payment tables in your own lunora/schema.ts by copying the block from the scaffolded lunora/payment/schema.ts (customers, events, paymentSessions, subscriptions, usageEvents). They must be declared INLINE and UNPREFIXED — codegen parses lunora/schema.ts as an AST so defineSchema({ ...paymentTables }) is silently skipped, and a .extend() merge would prefix the names @lunora/payment's store reads. Skip this step and the first ctx.payments.* call fails with UNKNOWN_TABLE. THEN wire the adapter into your Worker entry's createShardDO({ payment: (env) => ({ adapter: createStripeAdapter({ client: new Stripe(env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, { httpClient: Stripe.createFetchHttpClient() }), webhookSecret: env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET }), authorize: (ref) => ref === ctx.auth.userId, entitlements: { plans: { pro: { features: ['export'], limits: { api_calls: 1000 }, priceIds: ['price_xxx'] } } } }) }) — createStripeAdapter takes a single options object. Then add the POST /payment/webhook HTTP route (see the generated file header for the snippet), run `lunora codegen`, and set APP_BASE_URL, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in .dev.vars (wrangler secret put for the two secrets in production).

envVars.name: APP_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Public origin of this deployment (e.g. https://app.example.com). Used to build the checkout success/cancel and billing-portal return URLs — a Lunora context carries no Request to derive an origin from.

envVars.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
envVars.description: Stripe secret key (test mode: sk_test_...). Obtain from the Stripe dashboard.

envVars.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envVars.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...). Set in the Stripe dashboard for your /payment/webhook endpoint.
